summary.zh: 全球银行的办公口径清单——这是最接近 ESG 顾问日常中小客户的形态：电力、少量自有燃料、大量商务差旅，没有工厂。差旅按航空长/短途、铁路、道路分模式披露，能直接落成活动数据行，这在四份包里是独一份。
summary.en: A global bank's office-estate inventory — the shape closest to the SME clients an ESG consultant actually serves: electricity, a little owned fuel, a lot of business travel, no factories. Travel is disclosed by mode (short/long-haul air, rail, road), which makes it the only pack here whose Scope 3 lands as real activity rows rather than bare tCO2e.

expected_reconciliation.why: Travel is the reconciliation worth trusting here: air, rail and road together compute to ~40.5 ktCO2e against a disclosed 67,019 t for Category 6 (-39.5%). The disclosed figure carries radiative-forcing uplift and cabin-class weighting that the shipped economy-class factors do not, plus the 'other travel' mode this pack cannot map. Landing ~40% low is the expected shape, not a defect.

633,601 MWh at the US eGRID proxy gives ~233 ktCO2e against a disclosed 259,129 t location-based (-10.2%). Close, but by luck of proxy choice rather than by construction. Note that 2023 and 2024 publish a market-based Scope 2 only, so there is nothing like-for-like to compare those years against — the loader says so rather than scoring renewable procurement as calculation error.

gaps.reason: Mode is not disclosed, so no factor can be chosen honestly. Left out rather than guessed — 9% of 2025 travel distance.

gaps.reason: HSBC's financed and facilitated emissions (28.5 MtCO2e for oil and gas in 2024 alone) dwarf its operational footprint. They are Scope 3 Category 15 for a bank and are disclosed as sector intensities, which this data model does not represent. Deliberately out of scope for this pack.

notes: Business travel collapsed 25% in 2025 (383 -> 287 million km) while headcount stayed flat, and Scope 2 market-based fell 76% (83,760 -> 19,919 tCO2e) on renewable procurement. Two clean, real year-over-year stories for variance UI.

Hong Kong shows 0 tCO2e market-based against 77,221 location-based — RECs covering 100% of consumption. The single best real example of why dual reporting exists, and it is right there in the site list.
